description: This file defines a wizard interface for mapping buyers to auction lots in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form definitions, state transition logic, and methods for setting buyer mappings.

classes.name: wiz_auc_lots_buyer_map
classes.description: Wizard class managing the buyer mapping process for auction lots.

methods.name: _state_check
methods.description: Checks if there are auction lots without a buyer or login.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Initializes the wizard, prompts for buyer login if needed.

methods.name: _buyer_map_set
methods.description: Sets the buyer UID for selected auction lots based on login.
